say:4:1422644001:1.text: Though the curse has been lifted, he remains barred from stepping onto the Spirit Mound...
say:4:1422644001:1.source_cn: 已经解除了诅咒，却仍然不被允许踏足圣丘。

say:5:1422644002:1.text: The guardians of Ivoryshade, the Mysalind, and even the messenger butterflies are blocking his path.
say:5:1422644002:1.source_cn: 守护月影乡的迈萨林德和弥萨忒的使者蝴蝶都在无声地阻拦着。

say:6:1422644003:1.text: So, even now, we who were cast out are still turned away by Misarte...
say:6:1422644003:1.source_cn: 所以，被驱逐的我们，仍然被弥萨忒所厌弃吗？

say:7:1422644004:1.text: All signs point to a deeper cause for this resistance. We must uncover it before we can proceed.
say:7:1422644004:1.source_cn: 根据我们已知的信息来推断，这种抗拒必然有更深层的原因。...

say:8:1422644005:1.text: In this matter, we must entrust the task to those whom the Deer Spirit favors more.
say:8:1422644005:1.source_cn: 既然如此，那就得让更受鹿灵眷顾的人去寻求答案了。

say:9:1422644006:1.text: Bryon, seek out Eironn and have him return.
say:9:1422644006:1.source_cn: 布莱恩，设法叫埃隆回来吧。

say:10:1422644007:1.text: Eironn has been journeying of late, and his whereabouts are uncertain. I shall have Elona seek him out and deliver your summons.
say:10:1422644007:1.source_cn: 埃隆最近在外游历，位置难以确定。我会让艾洛娜去寻找，同...

narration:12:1422644008:0.text: You all watch as Bryon casts Elona into the sky and flies away. All that remains is to wait.
narration:12:1422644008:0.source_cn: 布莱恩在你们的注视下放飞了艾洛娜，接下来就是等待了……

say:13:1422644009:1.text: Very well. As we await Eironn's return, guide our guests through these lands. Let Indris, above all, walk the soil where his ancestors once roamed.
say:13:1422644009:1.source_cn: 很好。在等待他归来的时间里，就请你带着我们的客人四处走...

say:14:1422644010:1.text: Understood, Master Arden. I shall do my utmost to guide them well.
say:14:1422644010:1.source_cn: 我明白了，雅顿老师。我会尽我所能为诸位提供向导。

say:15:1422644011:1.text: Thank you, Master Bryon. I'm also eager to learn how this place differs from Sal'thorin.
say:15:1422644011:1.source_cn: 感谢你，布莱恩先生。我也……很好奇，这里和萨洛克兰的区别。

choice_prompt:16:1422644011.text: Thank you, Master Bryon. I'm also eager to learn how this place differs from Sal'thorin.
choice_prompt:16:1422644011.source_cn: 感谢你，布莱恩先生。我也……很好奇，这里和萨洛克兰的区别。

say:19:1422644012:1.text: Great! Now we can all play together!
say:19:1422644012:1.source_cn: 好诶！因度厄，主人、我和漫漫也可以带你一起玩。
say:19:1422644012:1.male: Great! Now we can all play together!
say:19:1422644012:1.female: Great! Now we can all play together!

say:20:1422644013:1.text: Stupid Chippy, stop thinking about playing all the time. Indris, there's no need to worry about Sal'thorin. Ravion is there managing the city.
say:20:1422644013:1.source_cn: 笨蛋满满，只想着玩。因度厄，别太担心萨洛克兰。沙利叶在...

say:21:1422644014:1.text: You're right. My thanks to you all. This chance to set foot in our ancestral homeland holds great meaning for me.
say:21:1422644014:1.source_cn: 你说得对，有劳各位。能有机会踏足曾经的家园……这对我来...
